email.testQueued: Test email queued. It appears below in a few seconds.
email.adminsOnly: Only administrators can see email delivery.
email.capturingTitle: Emails are not reaching real inboxes
email.capturingBody: This server sends email to a test inbox (such as Mailpit), so invitations, reminders and password resets are collected there and never delivered. Connect a real provider below, then restart the API and worker.
email.queueBody_one: {{count}} email is waiting to be sent. If this number does not go down, the background worker is not running.
email.queueBody_other: {{count}} emails are waiting to be sent. If this number does not go down, the background worker is not running.
email.queueHint: Waiting now, and failed for good in the last 7 days.
email.recentDescription: Emails to people of this workspace, newest first.
email.none: No emails yet. Send a test email to see how it goes.
email.setupDescription: Set these in the server's .env file (secrets stay out of the browser).
email.setupAfter: Then run: docker compose up -d api worker. Use “Send me a test email” to check.
